subject: Add Android aural quiz curriculum and rename song UI to Playback
featureDelta: Adds pure deterministic aural curriculum, seven distinct evidence skills, adaptive scheduling, supported/independent/transfer gates, four microphone tasks, durable provenance and one-shot audio; renames song Quiz UI to Playback.
finalDisposition: Retain learning/audio/evidence behavior; six-family landing is superseded by catalog. Do not port the old song Quiz naming.

subject: Simplify Aural Quiz with family navigation and phase tabs
featureDelta: Adds family/progression hierarchy and Recognize/Recall/Sing tabs, named variant targets and persistence; selecting an answer-bearing progression always makes evidence supported practice.
finalDisposition: Retain mode/evidence/navigation semantics; replace historical family landing with current catalog.

subject: Preserve playback frame rate across presentation changes
featureDelta: Reapply display frame-rate preference on destination entry, presentation/lock changes and resume; compute supported maximum from display modes rather than previously capped active rate.
finalDisposition: Retain timeline preference/continuity intent; Android window refresh APIs require browser adaptation.

subject: Consolidate aural practice modes and reuse shared sound settings
featureDelta: Consolidates activities under three practice modes, repeats weak tasks, chooses least-practiced singing kind, and uses shared default instrument/Settings.
finalDisposition: Retain; presentation grouping must not merge seven evidence cells or award independent mastery to named practice.

subject: Preserve local playback icon and accessibility inspection helper
featureDelta: Adds press-and-hold pointer drawable and accessibility dump text helper.
finalDisposition: Port relevant icon/accessibility semantics; Android dump script is development tooling, not PWA product feature.

subject: Add offline popularity enrichment and portable corpus selector
featureDelta: Adds offline popularity normalization and deterministic song-to-section-to-occurrence weighted selector, immutable replay context and shared fixtures; missing confidence is neutral and repetition cannot inflate song weight.
finalDisposition: Reuse portable contract/tooling with browser-safe hashing; selector v1 superseded by overlap-aware v2 for new selection, keep frozen replay compatibility when relevant.

subject: Merge branch 'codex/aural-popularity' into codex/aural-corpus-index
featureDelta: Integrates 2f4f1011 popularity/selector branch; first-parent delta adds same five files.
finalDisposition: Integration only; do not count duplicate features.

subject: Merge branch 'codex/aural-miner' into codex/aural-corpus-index
featureDelta: Integrates c8fe5e83 miner branch: suffix mining, transition/window union coverage and recurring longer-pattern selection.
finalDisposition: Backend preparation dependency, not new on-device screen; ingest published artifacts instead of mining in browser.

subject: Build independent normalized corpus snapshots and Android occurrence exports
featureDelta: Adds normalized immutable source snapshots, runtime occurrence exporter, reviewed family mappings and indexed SQLite contract independent of Android user data.
finalDisposition: Retain producer/provenance contract; full catalog v3 later augments runtime curriculum sidecar.

subject: Integrate indexed corpus examples and Aural Quiz preferences
featureDelta: Integrates read-only corpus provider, bounded target cache and selected-payload loading; popularity/variety/favorites/inversion settings, source provenance, synthetic fallback and separate inversion evidence.
finalDisposition: Retain provider boundary and settings; confirmed audible exposure and overlap refinements supersede initial listen-start bookkeeping.
